'''Cairdin''' was an [[Aiel]] from the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]]. He was of the [[Brothers of the Eagle]] society. 

== Appearance ==
He was young.

== Activities ==
He, along with part of his sept, are dispersed through a [[gateway]] near the [[Plains of Maredo]]. He runs to [[Maeric]] with the news that a huge force of wetlanders are coming towards them. His clan engages the enemy and he probably doesn't survive the exchange.
